title: This little corner of the internet
description: A personal website with a playful desk, room for notes, and content that grows with me.
longDescription: My personal website: a place for projects, learning notes, and the tools I use. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and shadcn/ui, with a shared visual language and editable JSON content.

title: Tools for justice & truth
description: A website and digital tools to support the work of Promise for Justice & Truth.
longDescription: As CTO at Promise for Justice & Truth, I developed the organization’s website, family-facing forms, surveys, databases, and a dashboard. The work supported teams documenting cases of detainees and disappeared people in Syria.

title: A home on the web for Thabat
description: A clear, simple website and digital presence for a community association in Homs.
longDescription: As a volunteer technical and media lead at Thabat Association, I designed and developed the organization’s website and helped maintain its technical systems and online presence. Thabat works in Islamic education, da’wah, and cultural development.
